query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total!",
                  COUNT(*) FILTER (
                      WHERE last_heartbeat_at >= NOW() - make_interval(secs => $2::float8)
                  ) AS "online!",
                  COUNT(*) FILTER (
                      WHERE last_heartbeat_at >= NOW() - make_interval(days => $1)
                  ) AS "seen_week!",
                  COUNT(DISTINCT bridge_version) AS "versions!"
             FROM bridge_sessions
